payload.title: IMP-SES-01: Move Sessions identity normalize/discover/resolve into private subservice
payload.exclusiveLease: pkg/services/factory_sessions/internal/services/identity (create or relocate only this nested subservice)
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement Sessions identity as a private nested subservice under factory_sessions that normalizes, discovers, and resolves session keys behind the accepted CTR-SES root identity slice. Preserve public root behavior and unlock later IMP-SES packets without taking live-runtime, durable-execution, invocation, response-stream, or opening leases.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Sessions identity normalize/discover/resolve lives under factory_sessions/internal/services/identity (or the equivalent nested private subservice path required by FND-02).
Stable session keys remain deterministic; ambiguous and not-found cases return the typed failures published by CTR-SES.
Public Sessions root identity behavior stays equivalent for representative success and typed failure cases already covered by CTR-SES characterization.
No peer implementation, filesystem/SQL/OS effect types, Runtime/Petri types, or Wire/root construction ownership appear in the identity subservice public surface.
A fake peer can exercise the root identity slice through the private implementation; focused identity tests cover stable keys plus ambiguous/not-found cases.
Typecheck/lint and focused Sessions identity tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Identity subservice only; do not implement IMP-SES-02..06 in this packet.
Do not edit CLI-manifest/generation owned by schema-cli-static-docs-models-mcp-migration (PR #1262).
Do not edit workers construction owned by standardized-provider-neutral-conductor (PR #1267).
Do not take CTR-RUN/CTR-REC/CTR-WRK leases or change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.
Do not expand into live_runtime, durable_execution, invocation, response_stream, or runtime_opening directories.
